question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who travels from place to place, especially for work
solution:
The correct answer is: **Itinerant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Itinerant"** refers to a person who travels from place to place, especially for work or duty. (भ्रमणशील)

 
 
• **Example:** The itinerant vendor moved from town to town selling his handmade crafts.
 
 
 
• **"Itinerant"** emphasizes movement and traveling for a specific purpose, usually related to work or duties. (भ्रमणशील)
 
 
• **Example:** Many itinerant workers migrate to different states during harvest seasons.
 
 
 
• Hence, the best one-word substitute for the given phrase is **"Itinerant."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Itinerant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Vagrant** (आवारा): A person who has no settled home or job and wanders from place to place.

 
 
• **Example:** The police offered shelter to the vagrant who had been sleeping on the streets.
 
 
 
• **Nomad** (यायावर): A member of a group of people who move from place to place instead of living in one location.
 
 
• **Example:** The nomads traveled across the desert in search of water and pasture.
 
 
 
• **Pilgrim** (तीर्थयात्री): A person who journeys to a sacred place for religious purposes.
 
 
• **Example:** The pilgrim visited Varanasi during the holy festival.
